summary: You can now take a group out of PIM Manager with all its delegations in one click.

new.title: Quick clean-up on a group row
new.text: One button takes a group out of PIM Manager together with every delegation that names it, staged in Pending changes.

fixes.title: Records grouped more clearly
fixes.text: Records are grouped as Direct groups, Indirect groups, Who gets what and Other records, and the delegations view lists more group types.
